title: Community channels and roles added
summary: Added submissions channels, the Contributor role, Top Schematics wanted, and new community roles for polls, updates, and emergencies.
description: New community channels and roles for schematic submissions, polls, updates, emergency pings, and Question of the day.

body.text: Added 📤╏submissions and the @Contributor role. To earn the role, post a farm schematic in 📤╏submissions and wait for it to be verified.
Created a channel to request schematics for specific DNs called Top Schematics wanted.
Created @.poll and @.update for community polls and changes.
Created @emergency for urgent pings when something bad happens. Ping @SLOA | ro_mihaiu or send a DM to get the role.
Created @unknown-role and the unknown channel for Question of the day.
